item.title: Financial News Sentiment and Commodity Market Dynamics
item.description: Commodity markets respond to supply and demand conditions, expectations and information flows that change continuously. Beyond reporting relevant facts, financial news can reflect perceptions of risks, opportunities and future scenarios. This project seeks to study the relationship between the sentiment expressed in that news and the evolution of returns and volatility in these markets. The project is carried out by Juan Illanes (Ph.D. student, Universidad del Desarrollo), with advisors Juan Pablo Couyoumdjian (School of Government, Universidad del Desarrollo; CICS member) and María Paz Raveau (Faro UDD; CICS member).

item.title: FullCICS Session: Unpacking the Unpredictable with Bastián González Bustamante
item.description: On October 9th we will have a FullCICS discussion session open to the entire community, organized by PoliCICS. On this occasion, we will have an international guest from Leiden University. Bastián González Bustamante will present his work ‘Unpacking the Unpredictable: From Machine Learning to Generative AI for Detecting Crises in Presidential Democracies’, hosted at OBPEX: https://obpex.com/enlace-udp.
